findings.passage: And then really where it was solidified the need to have the Second Amendment and have it be unencumbered was during BLM riots and during COVID because we saw the way that the government was willing to overreach and to take away your civil liberties.
findings.note: From the transcript of the CD1 primary debate on On the Record (at 41:13), answering a question on his past gun posts. He says he came to own a gun for home defense and ties his view of the Second Amendment to his experience of those events.
subjects: gun rights and the Second Amendment in general

findings.passage: In Congress, I’ll be a voice for the Valley—not the D.C. establishment. That means protecting our water, standing up for our farmers and ranchers, defending our Second Amendment rights, and stopping out-of-control federal mandates that hurt our families, small businesses, and schools.
